name: Teddy X Ultra
description: Teddy X Ultra - WhatsApp MD Multi-Device Bot powered by Teddy tech

SESSION_ID.description: Your TEDDY-XMD session ID. Keep this secret.

BOT_MODE.description: Bot mode: public, private, group, or pm.

ANTIDELETE_MODE.description: Anti-delete mode: off, chat, or private.

STATUS_MODE.description: Presence: off, typing, recording, or recordtype.

ANTILINK_ACTION.description: Default for new groups: delete, kick, or off. Existing groups keep their saved settings.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner phone number with country code, digits only.

AUTOSTATUSVIEW.description: Automatically view WhatsApp statuses: true or false.

AUTOREACTSTATUS.description: Automatically react to WhatsApp statuses: true or false.

AUTOREACTSTATUS_EMOJI.description: Emoji used for automatic status reactions. Use one or more emojis, e.g. 💙 or 💙 ✅ 🔥.

AUTOREACTSTATUS_RANDOM.description: Choose a random emoji from AUTOREACTSTATUS_EMOJI when multiple emojis are configured.
